items.summary: Merge cb2a815 (2026-08-04) silently reverted builder/build.py and config/thresholds.json to the June lineage, dropping FIVE med-spa treatments that were already committed and merged in July: iv-therapy, morpheus8, dermal-fillers, hydrafacial, chemical-peel. The builder stopped rather than guess whether this was intentional.

evidence.merge_commit: cb2a815 — parents 085fc2f (Jun 6, plastic-surgery vertical) and 3dce59c (Jul 26, PR #27)
evidence.build_py: each treatment had 5 dict entries (TREATMENT_NAMES / FAQS / UNITS / GUIDANCE / DESC); HEAD has 0 for all five
evidence.config_thresholds: seed_scope.treatments on Jul side = 10 slugs; at HEAD = the original 5. Config is HARD-GATED — builder cannot restore it.
evidence.note: The plastic-surgery vertical (June side) survived the merge intact; only the July med-spa expansion was lost.

items.why_builder_stopped: Restoring is a revert-of-a-revert across two lineages, and the config half is hard-gated. Whether the July med-spa expansion was intentionally abandoned in favour of the plastic-surgery vertical is a strategy call the builder must not make.
items.operator_decision_needed: REMAINING: re-add the five slugs to config/thresholds.json -> seed_scope.categories['med-spa'].treatments (and seed_scope.treatments for back-compat): hydrafacial, chemical-peel, dermal-fillers, iv-therapy, morpheus8. Hard-gated — operator only. Until then builder/build.py carries the definitions but no pages are generated for them.

data_coverage_if_restored.iv-therapy: 8 clinics, exactly 2 each in miami-lakes, doral, plantation, parkland -> 4 pages at min_listings=2; ZERO clinics report an iv-therapy starting price, so every page renders the no-prices FAQ variant and a 'request a quote' cost block
data_coverage_if_restored.caution: Verify the other four treatments' listing counts before activating; thin treatment x city pages will be held by the quality gate.

stage_2.audit_note: templates/ AUDIT COMPLETE (2026-08-18). `git diff 3dce59c HEAD -- templates/` reviewed line by line. Removed-line count per file: advertise 0, claim 0, guide 0, hub 0, treatment-page 0 (after the canonical restore), home.html.j2 28. Those 28 lines are a DELIBERATE June rewrite making the homepage category-aware for the plastic-surgery vertical (treatment pills -> category pills; flat treat-grid -> per-category blocks; setActiveTreat -> setActiveCat). Treatment-level filtering is retained (activeTreat/okTreat/data-treats all still present) and the live homepage renders all 14 treatment cards including the newly-activated hydrafacial and chemical-peel. NOT a regression. The favicon/apple-touch-icon/og-image/twitter-card additions across 5 templates are June work HEAD gained, not lost. CONCLUSION: the canonical tag was the only template casualty of cb2a815 and it is fixed.
